content.json:
## IIS Servers – Monitoring & Security
Data source: `W3CIISLog` via Azure Monitor Agent + Data Collection Rule. Agent health from `Heartbeat`.

parameters.name: Server
parameters.query:
W3CIISLog
| summarize by Computer
| order by Computer asc

parameters.name: Site
parameters.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| summarize by sSiteName
| order by sSiteName asc

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| summarize Requests = count(), UniqueIPs = dcount(cIP), Servers = dcount(Computer),
    Rate4xx = round(100.0 * countif(toint(scStatus) between (400 .. 499)) / count(), 2),
    Rate5xx = round(100.0 * countif(toint(scStatus) >= 500) / count(), 2),
    AvgMs = round(avg(TimeTaken), 0)
| extend b = bag_pack('Requests', Requests, 'Unique client IPs', UniqueIPs, 'Servers', Servers, '4xx rate %', Rate4xx, '5xx rate %', Rate5xx, 'Avg response ms', AvgMs)
| mv-expand kind=array b
| project Metric = tostring(b[0]), Value = todouble(b[1])

W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| extend StatusClass = strcat(tostring(toint(scStatus) / 100), 'xx')
| summarize Requests = count() by StatusClass, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Requests over time by status class

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| summarize Requests = count() by Status = tostring(scStatus)
| top 10 by Requests
content.title: Status code split (top 10)

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| summarize Requests = count(), ClientIPs = dcount(cIP),
    Errors4xx = countif(toint(scStatus) between (400 .. 499)),
    Errors5xx = countif(toint(scStatus) >= 500),
    AvgMs = round(avg(TimeTaken), 0), P95Ms = percentile(TimeTaken, 95),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, Site = sSiteName
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Servers & sites

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| summarize Requests = count(), ClientIPs = dcount(cIP), Errors5xx = countif(toint(scStatus) >= 500) by csUriStem
| top 20 by Requests
content.title: Top requested URIs

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| summarize Requests = count(), ClientIPs = dcount(cIP) by csUserAgent
| top 15 by Requests
content.title: Top user agents

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| where toint(scStatus) >= 500
| summarize Errors = count() by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: 5xx errors over time by server

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| where toint(scStatus) >= 400
| summarize Count = count() by Status = strcat(scStatus, '.', scSubStatus), Win32Status = tostring(scWin32Status)
| top 20 by Count
content.title: Status.SubStatus / Win32 status (4xx & 5xx)

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| where toint(scStatus) >= 500
| summarize Count = count(), Servers = make_set(Computer, 10), ClientIPs = dcount(cIP), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by csUriStem, Status = strcat(scStatus, '.', scSubStatus), Win32Status = tostring(scWin32Status)
| top 25 by Count
content.title: Top failing URIs (5xx)

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| where toint(scStatus) == 404
| summarize Count = count(), ClientIPs = dcount(cIP), SampleIPs = make_set(cIP, 5) by csUriStem
| top 25 by Count
content.title: Top 404 URIs

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| where toint(scStatus) between (400 .. 499)
| summarize Errors = count() by Status = tostring(scStatus), bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: 4xx errors over time

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| summarize P50 = percentile(TimeTaken, 50), P95 = percentile(TimeTaken, 95), P99 = percentile(TimeTaken, 99)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Response time percentiles (ms)

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| summarize Requests = count(), AvgMs = round(avg(TimeTaken), 0), P95Ms = percentile(TimeTaken, 95), MaxMs = max(TimeTaken) by csUriStem
| where Requests >= 10
| top 20 by P95Ms
content.title: Slowest URIs (min 10 requests)

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| summarize SentMB = round(sum(scBytes) / 1048576.0, 2), ReceivedMB = round(sum(csBytes) / 1048576.0, 2)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Bandwidth (MB) – needs sc-bytes / cs-bytes enabled in IIS

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| summarize Requests = count() by csMethod
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Requests by method

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| summarize Requests = count() by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Requests per server

content.query:
let AttackPattern = @"(\.\./|\.\.\\|%2e%2e|%252e|union[\s+]+select|select.+from|<script|%3cscript|javascript:|xp_cmdshell|/etc/passwd|win\.ini|cmd\.exe|powershell|/bin/(ba)?sh|base64_decode|eval\(|\.env$|\.git/|wp-login|phpmyadmin)";
let Scanners = dynamic(["sqlmap","nikto","nmap","acunetix","nessus","dirbuster","gobuster","masscan","zgrab","nuclei","wpscan","burp","openvas","feroxbuster","ffuf"]);
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| extend uri = tolower(strcat(csUriStem, '?', csUriQuery))
| summarize AttackLike = countif(uri matches regex AttackPattern),
    ScannerIPs = dcountif(cIP, csUserAgent has_any (Scanners)),
    AuthFailures = countif(toint(scStatus) in (401, 403)),
    RareMethods = countif(csMethod !in ('GET', 'POST', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'))
| extend b = bag_pack('Attack-like requests', AttackLike, 'Scanner IPs', ScannerIPs, 'Auth failures (401/403)', AuthFailures, 'Rare HTTP methods', RareMethods)
| mv-expand kind=array b
| project Metric = tostring(b[0]), Value = todouble(b[1])

let AttackPattern = @"(\.\./|\.\.\\|%2e%2e|%252e|union[\s+]+select|select.+from|<script|%3cscript|javascript:|xp_cmdshell|/etc/passwd|win\.ini|cmd\.exe|powershell|/bin/(ba)?sh|base64_decode|eval\(|\.env$|\.git/|wp-login|phpmyadmin)";
let Scanners = dynamic(["sqlmap","nikto","nmap","acunetix","nessus","dirbuster","gobuster","masscan","zgrab","nuclei","wpscan","burp","openvas","feroxbuster","ffuf"]);
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| extend uri = tolower(strcat(csUriStem, '?', csUriQuery))
| where uri matches regex AttackPattern and toint(scStatus) between (200 .. 299)
| summarize Requests = count(), SampleURIs = make_set(strcat(csUriStem, iff(csUriQuery == '-', '', strcat('?', csUriQuery))), 5),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by ClientIP = cIP, Computer, Site = sSiteName, UserAgent = csUserAgent
| order by Requests desc
| take 100
content.title: Attack-like requests that SUCCEEDED (2xx) – investigate first

content.query:
let AttackPattern = @"(\.\./|\.\.\\|%2e%2e|%252e|union[\s+]+select|select.+from|<script|%3cscript|javascript:|xp_cmdshell|/etc/passwd|win\.ini|cmd\.exe|powershell|/bin/(ba)?sh|base64_decode|eval\(|\.env$|\.git/|wp-login|phpmyadmin)";
let Scanners = dynamic(["sqlmap","nikto","nmap","acunetix","nessus","dirbuster","gobuster","masscan","zgrab","nuclei","wpscan","burp","openvas","feroxbuster","ffuf"]);
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| extend uri = tolower(strcat(csUriStem, '?', csUriQuery))
| where uri matches regex AttackPattern or csUserAgent has_any (Scanners)
| summarize Requests = count(), SampleURIs = make_set(strcat(csUriStem, iff(csUriQuery == '-', '', strcat('?', csUriQuery))), 5),
    Statuses = make_set(scStatus, 5), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by ClientIP = cIP, UserAgent = csUserAgent, Computer
| order by Requests desc
| take 100
content.title: Suspicious patterns (SQLi / XSS / traversal / webshell / scanners)

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| summarize Requests = count(), Errors4xx = countif(toint(scStatus) between (400 .. 499)), DistinctURIs = dcount(csUriStem) by ClientIP = cIP
| top 25 by Errors4xx
| extend Pct4xx = round(100.0 * Errors4xx / Requests, 1), Country = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(ClientIP).country)
| project ClientIP, Country, Requests, Errors4xx, Pct4xx, DistinctURIs
content.title: Top client IPs by 4xx

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| where csMethod !in ('GET', 'POST', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS')
| summarize Requests = count(), URIs = make_set(csUriStem, 5), Statuses = make_set(scStatus, 5) by csMethod, ClientIP = cIP, Computer
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Rare HTTP methods (PUT / DELETE / TRACE / PROPFIND …)

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| where toint(scStatus) in (401, 403)
| summarize Failures = count(), Users = make_set(csUserName, 10), URIs = make_set(csUriStem, 5)
    by ClientIP = cIP, Computer, Window = bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where Failures >= {FailThreshold}
| order by Failures desc
content.title: Auth failures – brute-force candidates (401/403 per 10 min ≥ threshold)

content.query:
let lookback = 7d;
let iis = W3CIISLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| summarize LastIISLog = max(TimeGenerated), Sites = make_set(sSiteName, 10) by Host = tolower(tostring(split(Computer, '.')[0]));
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where Category == 'Azure Monitor Agent'
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated), AgentVersion = take_any(Version), OS = take_any(OSName) by Host = tolower(tostring(split(Computer, '.')[0]))
| join kind=rightouter iis on Host
| extend Server = Host1
| extend HeartbeatAgeMin = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastHeartbeat), LogAgeMin = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastIISLog)
| extend Status = case(isnull(LastHeartbeat) or HeartbeatAgeMin > 15, '🔴 Agent not reporting',
                       LogAgeMin > {StaleMinutes}, '🟡 Agent OK – IIS logs stale (check DCR / log path)',
                       '🟢 Healthy')
| project Server, Status, LastHeartbeat, HeartbeatAgeMin, LastIISLog, LogAgeMin, Sites, AgentVersion, OS
| order by Status desc, LogAgeMin desc
content.title: IIS server ingestion health (last 7 days, independent of Time Range)

content.query:
W3CIISLog
| where '*' in ({Server}) or Computer in ({Server})
| where '*' in ({Site}) or sSiteName in ({Site})
| summarize Events = count() by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Log events per server

content.query:
Usage
| where DataType == 'W3CIISLog'
| summarize GB = round(sum(Quantity) / 1024.0, 3) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
content.title: W3CIISLog ingested volume (GB/day)

content.json:
### Troubleshooting a 🟡 / 🔴 server
- **🔴 Agent not reporting** – AMA extension/service down, Arc agent disconnected, or outbound blocked to `*.ods.opinsights.azure.com`, `*.ingest.monitor.azure.com`, `*.handler.control.monitor.azure.com`.
- **🟡 Logs stale** – agent is alive but no IIS data:
  - Server is not associated with the IIS DCR (Monitor → Data Collection Rules → Resources).
  - DCR log path does not match the site's log directory (default `C:\inetpub\logs\LogFiles\W3SVC*`).
  - IIS logging is not in **W3C** format, or logging is disabled for the site.
  - Low-traffic site – raise *Log stale after (min)* above.
- **Empty columns** (bytes, referer, host) – enable the fields in IIS Manager → Logging → Select Fields.
